name: 健康保険・介護保険 (Kyokai Kenpo health and nursing care insurance)

references.title: 健康保険法
references.quote: 標準報酬月額 grades 1–50, 58,000–1,390,000; 標準賞与額: the bonus with fractions under 1,000 yen dropped, at most 5,730,000 in a fiscal year. Premium is the standard remuneration times the rate, borne equally; the employer deducts the employee half from wages. Premiums run for every month of insured status, with or without pay that month (arts.156, 161). The grade is fixed by 資格取得時決定 (art.42), 定時決定 (art.41, April–June remuneration) and 随時改定 (art.43, last three months). The employee half of a month is deducted from the pay of the following month; a leaver at a month end has both months deducted from the final pay (art.167(1) proviso).

name: 健康保険・介護保険 標準賞与額 (health insurance on bonuses)

references.title: 健康保険法
references.quote: The standard bonus amount (fractions under 1,000 dropped) up to 5,730,000 accumulated over the fiscal year from 1 April, at the month's health and nursing rate, deducted from the bonus itself.

references.title: Cap: ¥5,730,000 per fiscal year (1 April–31 March). Prior bonus paid in the same fiscal year reduces the remaining cap. The pension bonus cap is separate and applies per payment month.

name: 子ども・子育て支援金 (child and childrearing support levy)

references.title: 健康保険法; 子ども・子育て支援法
references.locator: 健保法156条1項、160条の2、161条; 子ども・子育て支援法71条の3
references.quote: As amended by 子ども・子育て支援法等の一部を改正する法律 (Law 47 of 2024): from the April 2026 premium (May payment) the health insurer collects the support levy with the health insurance premium on the same health 標準報酬月額 (grades 1–50, 58,000–1,390,000, not the pension clamp) and 標準賞与額, borne equally by employer and employee; the 2026 rate is 0.23%, uniform for every insurer (こども家庭庁). Charged to a health-insured person only (not at 75 and over).

name: 子ども・子育て支援金 標準賞与額 (support levy on bonuses)

references.title: 健康保険法
references.quote: The support levy on the standard bonus amount (the health cap applies), deducted from the bonus.

references.title: Cap: ¥5,730,000 per fiscal year (1 April–31 March). Prior bonus paid in the same fiscal year reduces the remaining cap. The pension bonus cap is separate and applies per payment month.

name: 厚生年金保険 (employees' pension insurance)

references.title: 厚生年金保険法
references.quote: 18.3% of the standard monthly remuneration and the standard bonus amount (fixed from September 2017), borne equally (art.82). 標準報酬月額 grades 1–32, 88,000 (under 93,000) to 650,000 (635,000 and over) — the health grade clamped to that range (art.20). Standard bonus: the bonus with fractions under 1,000 yen dropped, at most 1,500,000 per month of payment (art.24の4). Insured person is under 70 (the loss falls on the day before the 70th birthday, art.14(5), so the month it falls in is not charged, art.19(1)). Collection follows HEALTH (art.84).

name: 厚生年金保険 標準賞与額 (pension on bonuses)

references.title: 厚生年金保険法
references.quote: The standard bonus amount up to 1,500,000 a payment month at 18.3%, half each, deducted from the bonus.

references.title: Cap: ¥1,500,000 per payment month. Bonuses paid in different months each get their own cap; earlier months do not reduce this month's remaining cap. Health and child-support bonuses use the separate fiscal-year cap.

name: 子ども・子育て拠出金 (employer child contribution)

references.title: 子ども・子育て支援法; 子ども・子育て支援法施行令
references.quote: Rate 3.6/1000 from April 2020: the employer alone pays 0.36% of each welfare-pension-insured employee's standard monthly remuneration and standard bonus, collected with the pension premium. Per-person amounts truncated to the yen; the notice truncates the employer total. The exempt maternity and childcare months carry no contribution (art.71(2)).

name: 雇用保険 (employment insurance)

references.title: 労働保険の保険料の徴収等に関する法律
references.quote: Rates per 1000 of wages paid, 令和8年度 notice: general business 5.0 worker and 8.5 employer; agriculture, forestry, fisheries and sake brewing 6.0 and 9.5; construction 6.0 and 10.5. Worker share deducted from wages: 50 sen or less drops, above 50 sen rounds up.

name: 雇用保険 賞与 (employment insurance on bonuses)

references.title: 労働保険の保険料の徴収等に関する法律; 雇用保険法
references.locator: 徴収法11条、31条; 雇用保険法4条4項
references.quote: A bonus is a wage; the worker's share is computed on the bonus payment and deducted from it.

name: 労災保険 (workers' accident compensation insurance)

references.title: 労働者災害補償保険法; 労働保険の保険料の徴収等に関する法律
references.locator: 労災保険法3条; 徴収法11〜12条、12条3項
references.quote: The employer alone pays the business-type rate, or the merit-adjusted rate (art.12(3)), on every wage paid to every worker; an officer who is not a worker is outside it (労働基準法9条). Truncated to the yen per person; the annual declaration settles the total.

name: 一般拠出金 (asbestos relief general levy)

references.title: 石綿による健康被害の救済に関する法律; 同法施行令
references.quote: Rate 0.02/1000 from April 2014: every employer under workers' accident insurance pays 0.02/1000 of the same wages, declared and paid with the annual labour insurance declaration. Truncated to the yen per person.

name: 源泉所得税及び復興特別所得税 (salary and bonus withholding)

references.title: 所得税法; 復興財源確保法
references.locator: 所得税法183条、185条、186条; 復興財源確保法28〜31条
references.quote: 2026 月額表: 甲欄 when the 給与所得者の扶養控除等申告書 is filed with this employer (art.194), by the 電算機計算の特例; without it the 乙欄, less 1,610 yen for each dependant on a 従たる給与 declaration; 日雇 pay on the 丙欄 (art.185(1)(iii)). A bonus goes by the 算出率の表 (別表第三) on the previous month's pay after premiums, or by the 月額表 with no such pay or a bonus over ten times it, on a sixth, or a twelfth for a period over six months (art.186). Base: the payment's taxable pay less the premiums deducted from it (art.185(1)(i)); NON_TAXABLE_PAY stays out (art.9(1)(v), 所得税基本通達 28-1). Tables apply to pay payable from 1 January (art.185); the table year follows the pay day.

name: 年末調整 (year-end adjustment)

references.title: 所得税法
references.quote: At the last salary payment of the year (a pay day in December, or the exit month of a leaver who dies, leaves in December or departs abroad, or the month of a departure abroad) the employer settles the year's tax of a resident who filed the 扶養控除等申告書 and earned 20,000,000 or less. 令和7年分 tables: 給与所得控除 at least 650,000 (別表第五), 基礎控除 950,000 at 1,320,000 or less down to 580,000 by 合計所得金額. Tax: the 速算表 on the taxable income (1,000 yen down) less the housing loan credit, times 102.1%, 100 yen down; the adjustment is that annual tax less the year's withholding (a refund when negative). Computed on a December pay day and at a qualifying exit (年末調整のしかた 令和8年分 pp.5-6: departure abroad, or no further salary expected after a disability exit or with the year's pay at most the row's limit). Year figures read the balance, each scheme apart, so resident tax stays out. YEAR_END_REFUND returns an over-withholding.

name: 退職所得の源泉徴収 (retirement income withholding)

references.title: 所得税法
references.locator: 30条（退職所得）、89条（税率）、203条（源泉徴収）
references.quote: 退職所得の金額は、退職手当等の収入金額から退職所得控除額を控除した残額の二分の一に相当する金額とする。 Service years round a part year up. Five years or less: an officer gets no half (特定役員退職手当等); for others only the first 3,000,000 of the remainder is halved (短期退職手当等). The taxable amount drops to the 1,000 yen; the tax to the yen. Without the 退職所得の受給に関する申告書 the payment is withheld at 20.42% (art.201(3)): RETIREMENT_ALLOWANCE_UNDECLARED. A non-resident is withheld at 20.42% (art.212). 解雇予告手当 is retirement income (所得税基本通達 30-5).

name: 退職所得の分離課税 住民税 (resident tax on retirement income)

references.title: 地方税法
references.locator: 50条の5（退職所得の分離課税）、328条の5（特別徴収）
references.quote: 退職所得に係る住民税は、退職手当等の支払者が特別徴収する。 Same taxable amount as the income tax, 1,000 yen down; municipal 6% and prefectural 4%, each truncated to 100 yen.

name: 住民税 特別徴収 (resident tax special collection)

references.title: 地方税法
references.quote: The employer deducts the individual resident tax each month from June to the following May in the amounts the municipality's 特別徴収税額決定通知書 states — the June amount (which carries the rounding remainder) and the July–May monthly amount — and pays it by the 10th of the next month.
